name: ProtocolCostMath
summary: Protocol cost math for Swift: cost per session over a device life, the break-even where home gear beats the studio, and what a supplement stack costs per day.
description:
Swift math for pricing a wellness protocol by what it costs to run instead
of what the gear costs on the shelf: supplement stacks priced per serving
and per day, owned gear priced per session over the sessions it actually
gets, the session count where home equipment beats the studio or gym
lounge per-session rate, a year and a decade of venue spend at the current
cadence, and the savings (or waste) once the one-time gear cost enters.
Pure Foundation, no dependencies, Decimal throughout so cost audits never
inherit floating-point drift. Built by the Hacked Self team, which
publishes cost-per-session breakdowns and evidence audits for longevity
protocols and gear.
